invented.quote: At that hour no one else is on the farm.
invented.why: The brief says Tomás runs the 3 a.m. milking shift on his own, not that nobody else is anywhere on the farm.

invented.quote: I gave him that shift because he had earned my trust, and he has kept it.
invented.why: The brief does not state why the manager gave Tomás the 3 a.m. shift or whether he worked other shifts beforehand to earn trust.

invented.quote: He also taught himself our herd management software.
invented.why: The brief only says that he learned the software, not that he was self-taught.

invented.quote: Nobody asked him to take this on. He saw that the data could help the animals and learned to use it.
invented.why: The brief does not say that learning the software and flagging cows was an unprompted initiative.
